From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>

Date: 2029-06-15T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Week-of Jun 15 — Numbers turn-in & stakeholder rapid sync

Morning team —

Quick reminder: weekly numbers are due EOD Monday (June 17). I want to run a 20-minute rapid sync with key stakeholders on Tuesday at 09:00 PT to lock any late-stage changes and confirm commit signals. Please do the following before EOD Monday:

- Fill the attached weekly_numbers_template.xlsx with updated ARR, close probability, and expected close date for deals in your lane (use the ACME deal_lookup_ACME.csv to verify SKUs).
- Tag any deals you want on the Tuesday sync with the "lock-ask" flag in column H.
- Add one-line rationale for any move-to-commit in column I (reason + gating risk).

Agenda for Tuesday 09:00 PT (20 mins):
1) Quick lane roll (5 mins) — each rep 60s: highest-risk commit and any blockers
2) Finance signals (5 mins) — finance ops (ACME) will confirm invoice cadence/PO status
3) Escalation/tradeoffs (5 mins) — call out any requested SLA/discount exceptions
4) Action list and owners (5 mins) — who owns follow-ups and timelines

Call details: rapid_sync_calendar.ics attached; joining details in the calendar invite (be early). If you cannot make the 09:00 slot, ping me with a 2-line update and mark your spreadsheet row with "asap".

Why this matters: I want to reduce last-minute surprises in the close week. The goal is a single clean commit list by Wednesday morning with Finance and Sales aligned.

Thanks —
Connor
Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Director, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com
